usedFor: Shopify creates the products; QRtiger makes the scannable code. A “New Product” in Shopify can run “Create Static QR Code” so each listing gets a code you can print.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Static QR Code” in QRtiger
bestTemplate.why: Each product gets a code for its URL or text, with optional colors, frame and logo, ready for packaging or a flyer.

watchOut: “Create Static QR Code” encodes the URL or text you pass in, and a static code cannot change afterward. Check the link first. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling.
